text: Arcturus, Orion and Pleiades: Heb. Ash, Cesil, and Cimah
who can hinder him?: Heb. who can turn him away?
the proud helpers: Heb. helpers of pride, or strength
swift ships: Heb. ships of desire. Or, ships of Ebeh
abhor me: Or, make me to be abhorred
any daysman: Heb. one that should argue. Or, Umpire
but it is not so with me: Heb. but I am not so with myself
